newsitem.title: USA: Alternate Postal Delivery Inc Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Alternate Postal Delivery Inc Q1 net.

text.p: NOTE: Selling, general and administrative expenses decreased $492,535 during the 1997 Q1 from a year earlier due to planned overhead reductions from efficiencies amounting to about $230,000 and the elimination of nonrecurring charges of about $260,000 incurred in the first quarter of 1996.

Revenues fluctuate from quarter to quarter based in part on the timing of revenues derived from the Associate Network. In addition, during the three months ended March 31, 1997, the company realized a decrease of about 40 percent in revenue in the Address Specific Network as compared to the same period of the previous year, due to the effects of a U.S. Postal Service reclassification rate case.
